scope: Only three App UI sources over ready-browser eff5 baseline, coordinated with backend owner. Production GET await consumer; no alternate engine/store/HTTP/browser owner.

API.presentation: presentOriginal(_ presentation: LegadoOriginalBrowserPresentation) async throws -> LegadoOriginalBrowserCompletion
API.actualPresentationNotification: SourceBrowserPresenter.originalPageDidPresent; userInfo[taskID] only, actual UIKit completion after accepted Presented effect.
API.actualPageClose: @MainActor SourceBrowserPresenter.requestOriginalPageClose(taskID:String); routes mounted Coordinator→bridge→View.confirm, not a fabricated result.

behavior: Await continuation remains pending after real UIKit presentation; nonawait keeps its existing presented ACK/later page lifetime.

Done false evaluates one real WebKit JSON snapshot of window.location.href plus outerHTML, off-main JSON decode/UTF8 body<=4MiB/nonempty/URL budget, then checked Cookie capture. True does not require DOM and only returns refetchConfirmed after checked capture; same existing JVM performs its original HTTP request.

Visible Cancel uses the same guarded Cookie capture then typed BROWSER_CANCELLED, or actual capture failure. Explicit task cancellation first cancels ticket commit token, invalidates late Cookie writes, dismisses actual controller, cancels/drains mounted Coordinator task before resolving await and releasing existing queue.

Actual owned dismiss completion is authoritative; external UIKit removal has its actual viewDidDisappear signal. Pending close during present waits for real presentation completion. Completion/cancel is first terminal except explicit task cancellation before unfinished result publication.

Only awaited pages get the finite basicJs window.close signal. Existing WKUIDelegate.webViewDidClose and injected close both enter the same Coordinator; challenge-active page close is suppressed, while menu Done/visible Cancel keep their distinct original meanings. Existing challenge true→false signal confirms; ordinary didFinish does not complete await or issue an unguarded Cookie write.

Source Java/window.run/cache bridges remain absent on original route (sourceRunHandler:nil). Cookie capture uses existing CookieStore.captureWebKit with same Host grant validate plus ticket token/deadline; status effects Issued/Completed describe capture, not a fabricated persistence mutation. Errors/trace never include URL, HTML, headers or credentials.
taskOwnership: Presenter ticket owns presentation/finish drain. Existing Coordinator owns initial load/reload chain and confirmation; each new load awaits prior load; independent final drain awaits both latest initial and confirmation. No task awaits itself; callback semaphore/group never blocks main.

validation.NativeDefinitionOwnedByBackendAuthor: Existing awaited Native method gets real held-WK-seed/cancel regression; author binds final bytes/selector with whole snapshot.

limits: Grammar is not Swift typechecking; SDK/UIKit execution remains necessary for actor/continuation, WK, animation and Cookie behavior.
Backend/JVM/Host/Native/manifest are independently owned and not frozen by this UI-only artifact; whole author must bind all final sources and actual regression evidence.
POST/localHTML/WebJS/showBrowser/V2/browser shared-flight coalescing and raw network-result parity remain outside this GET await UI slice as declared by backend.

supersedes.reason: Independent P1: pending initial Cookie seed notify could issue an old URL/header request after cancellation. V1 retained immutable and not accepted as final.

initialLoadRepair: Existing Coordinator owns initialLoadWork and generation. Reload cancels and awaits the predecessor before new admission/IPC, retaining the entire chain. An old defer clears a handle only for its own still-current generation.

stopPageLoading seals future loads/navigation, rotates generation, stops the actual WKWebView and cancels handles. Explicit Presenter cancellation/close invokes it synchronously. Mounted controls are registered for BOTH original await and nonawait pages; final cancelAndDrain captures latest initial/confirmation tasks and awaits their actual completion.

All real issued WK setCookie callbacks are awaited via a nonthrowing continuation/DispatchGroup notify that only resumes. Cancellation never resumes it early; notify never issues HTTP. Before each seed IPC and before eventual webView.load, recheck generation, page lifetime/token and (await only) current Host grant/deadline.

Await seed records sourceBrowserCookieSeedIssued before first native IPC and SeedCompleted only when all requested native callbacks actually completed. Cancellation cannot roll back issued Cookie operations; no rollback or invented persistence fact is claimed. Subsequent guarded load is forbidden after cancel even for identical URL.

Original nonawait page uses only its explicit UI ticket token with distantFuture, so normal producer/session/revoke cleanup keeps the accepted page and any valid pending load alive. Explicit UI cancellation is distinct and closes/stops/drains it.

Per-Coordinator initialCookieSeeder defaults to actual existing WKHTTPCookieStore.setCookie. Its internal callback seam permits a Native regression to first invoke actual WK, hold delivery of that actual callback, observe cancel/drain pending, then release and verify no late loopback request. No global override, second store/engine/HTTP adapter or synthetic ACK.

definitionBoundary.actualNativeRegression: Backend author owns separate Native-v2 extension to existing single new await method; selector count unchanged. Must bind its exact frozen source separately; authored/unexecuted is not a pass.
